message.content: The archivist can confidently include claim A that staff digitised the master tape on Friday, supported by the transfer log (S1). Claim B should not be included, as the original tape casing is labeled SR-36, contradicting the claim it is SR-63 (S3). Claim C remains uncertain; while the programme grid allocates 35 minutes, this is only an estimate and engineers often removed content from masters, so the master tape’s actual audio length is unclear. Therefore, only claim A is reliably supported for the tape catalogue.
